assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is used to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and to assess for ischemic changes.
The service is consistent with diagnoses I25.10 and R00.2.
The clinical indication document supports the medical necessity of this service.
The service is described by SilverBridge's coverage expectation for pre-approved monitoring.
